terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, API names, paths, commands, shortcut keys, placeholders, and versions remain unchanged.
Japanese uses コントローラー, ボタン, 割り当て, スロット, and 入力; input listening never uses the media-capture sense.
Press is immediate 押す; release-based Tap is 短押し; 2回押し, 3回押し, and 長押し remain distinct, and completed Hold suppresses Tap.
リプレイ names the feature, リプレイバッファ its rolling recording, クリップ a saved video, 録画 the recording process, and 再生 ordinary playback.
キャプチャ, スクリーンショット, フレーム, ギャラリー, ライブラリ, オーバーレイ, and 通知領域 denote distinct product concepts.
Update security uses マニフェスト, チェックサム, 署名, 準備, トランザクション, 信頼状態, and データ破損.
Portable import uses ポータブル, 準備済み, ジャーナル, 文字列, ルート, インポート元, インスタンス, データベース, and 外部キー; portable:/ stays literal.
Japanese uses one Qt numerus form with explicit counters where the interface refers to captures or folders.
Controls use concise labels; explanatory sentences use consistent polite Japanese and natural particles and word order.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, location, control role, and neighboring UI; schema validity is not linguistic evidence.
Use concise controls without unnecessary です／ます, and consistent polite Japanese for explanatory prose.
Preserve placeholders, protected identifiers, shortcut keys, button names, paths, commands, punctuation tokens, and versions.
Review application, installer, Playnite, native launcher, startup, and release-note surfaces separately.
Resolve capture, replay, controller input, filesystem, database, and update-security terms from product context.
Avoid touchscreen タップ for controller-button gestures; name button presses while preserving activation timing.
